title: The Poor Gentleman
author: Hendrik Conscience

authorInfo.bio: Hendrik Conscience (1812–1883) is the credited author of this historical edition. The source reference provides their catalogue and biographical references.
authorInfo.edition: Complete source text and original edition credits retained.

description: "The Poor Gentleman" by Hendrik Conscience is a novel written during the mid-19th century. This work centers around Monsieur De Vlierbeck, a seemingly respectable gentleman, who conceals a profound suffering related to his financial struggles and his love for his daughter, Lenora.
